/*selectAccountDivideList*/
SELECT A.CODE2 -- 0 , A.TEXT1 -- 1 , A.TEXT4 -- 2 , A.TEXT2 -- 3 , B.TEXT4 TEXT44 -- 4 , B.TEXT3 -- 5 FROM ICOMCOD3 A, ICOMCOD2 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.CODE2 = B.CODE AND A.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND A.TYPE = 'ATOM' AND A.FLAG = 'Y' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND A.CODE1 = #{st_pa_account_type} ORDER BY A.VALUE1

/*getCod2C001DDLB*/
SELECT CODE as CODE , TEXT1 as TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE 1=1 AND COMPANY_CODE = #{com_code} AND TYPE = 'C001' AND FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY TEXT1

/*getLusrDDLB*/
SELECT A.LEGACY_USER_ID , A.USER_NAME_LOC , A.USER_ID as CODE , B.USER_ID , deocde(A.USER_ID,B.USER_ID , A.USER_NAME_LOC , A.LEGACY_USER_ID ) as TEXT1 FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID(+) AND A.COM_CODE = #{com_code} AND B.USER_ID(+) = #{SessionUserId} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND (B.STATUS IN ('C','R') OR B.STATUS IS NULL) ORDER BY A.USER_NAME_LOC

/*getCod2Z014DDLB*/
SELECT CODE as CODE , TEXT2 as TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE 1=1 AND COMPANY_CODE = #{com_code} AND TYPE = 'Z014' ORDER BY TEXT2

/*getCod3DDLB*/
SELECT CODE2 as CODE , TEXT1 as TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER = #{com_code} AND TYPE = 'MTOC' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE1 = #{code2} ORDER BY TEXT1
